description: Índices de Vulnerabilidad Ecológica y Socioeconómica del litoral andaluz en relación a eventos de subida del nivel del mar is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by descargasrediam.cica.es. Indices that are associated with key ecological attributes and socio-economic parameters of special interest that can be applied in the evaluation of the degree of affection of the coastal socio-ecosystem in the face of the effects of climate change. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Ecological and Socioeconomic Vulnerability Indexes of the Andalusian coast in relation to sea level rise events" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Indicadores ambientales, Biodiversidad, IDEAndalucia, Nivel del mar, Cambio climático, Costa. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
